meta.title: 阿里账上465亿美金，为什么还要卖股票
meta.title_en: Alibaba Has $46.5B in Cash — So Why Sell Shares?
meta.topic: 财经 · 阿里巴巴 · 配股

scenes.title_cn: 两个数字：史上最大配股与一个季度的燃料
scenes.title_en: Two Numbers: A Record Placement and One Quarter of Fuel
scenes.context: 800 亿港元配股是香港上市公司历史上最大的一笔一级市场增发，全球第三。而阿里上个季度资本开支约 740 亿港元——这笔融资只够烧一个季度。
sentences: 这是香港上市公司历史上最大的一笔一级市场增发。
This is the largest primary-market placement in the history of Hong Kong-listed companies.
placement（配售/增发）
阿里的账上躺着 465 亿美元的净现金。
Alibaba holds $46.5 billion in net cash on its books.
net cash（净现金）
这笔钱只够阿里花一个季度。
This money is only enough to fund the company for one quarter.
fund（为…提供资金）
paraphrase: No HK listing has ever raised this much in one placement.
At this burn rate, the cash lasts about a quarter.
scenes.speak: This is the largest primary-market placement in the history of Hong Kong-listed companies. Alibaba holds $46.5 billion in net cash on its books. This money is only enough to fund the company for one quarter.

scenes.title_cn: 机构抢疯了，二级市场跌懵了
scenes.title_en: Institutions Rushed In; the Secondary Market Was Shocked
scenes.context: 机构端一小时内超额认购，最终需求 280 亿美元，接近募资三倍；二级市场港股开盘一度暴跌 10%，最低 110.4 港元跌破配售价。
sentences: 机构一小时内就超额认购了。
Institutions oversubscribed within the first hour.
oversubscribe（超额认购）
最终需求是 280 亿美元，接近募资的三倍。
Final demand hit $28 billion — nearly three times the raise.
demand（需求）
港股开盘一度暴跌 10%，跌破配售价。
The stock opened down as much as 10%, falling below the placement price.
fall below（跌破）
paraphrase: Buyers scrambled to get in on the deal.
「机构与散户冰火两重天」换种说法
Two markets, two completely different moods.
scenes.speak: Institutions oversubscribed within the first hour. Final demand hit $28 billion — nearly three times the raise. The stock opened down as much as 10%, falling below the placement price.

scenes.title_cn: 为什么有钱还融资：现金是拿来活的
scenes.title_en: Why Raise with Cash in the Bank: Cash Is for Survival
scenes.context: 465 亿美元现金不是拿来烧的，是拿来活的。三年 3800 亿投资计划已投一半，还有 1900 亿要花；这笔钱买的是 AI 窗口期，全球巨头都在抢筹。
sentences: 现金不是用来烧的，是用来活的。
Cash isn't there to be burned; it's there to keep the company alive.
burn cash（烧钱）
三年 3800 亿的投资计划，还有 1900 亿要花。
They've committed to a 380-billion-yuan plan and still have 190 billion to spend.
committed（已承诺投入的）
这笔钱买的不是 GPU，是一个窗口期。
This money isn't buying GPUs — it's buying a window of opportunity.
window of opportunity（窗口期）
paraphrase: That cash is their rainy-day fund, not a toy.
「抢在窗口关闭前融资」换种说法
Raise while the market is willing to write the check.
scenes.speak: Cash isn't there to be burned; it's there to keep the company alive. They've committed to a 380-billion-yuan plan and still have 190 billion to spend. This money isn't buying GPUs — it's buying a window of opportunity.

scenes.title_cn: 为什么股权而非债：风险结构与估值语言
scenes.title_en: Equity, Not Debt: Risk Structure and Valuation Language
scenes.context: 债有硬性还本付息约束，而 AI 回报周期不确定，所以选股权——把不确定的回报风险交给新股东。800 亿增发只稀释约 3.8%，其余跌幅来自估值语言从现金牛到增长股的切换。
sentences: 债是有应约数的——不管 AI 有没有回本都得还钱。
Debt has a promise attached — you have to repay it whether AI pays off or not.
repay（偿还）
800 亿增发稀释了阿里股权约 3.8%。
The 80-billion-HKD placement dilutes Alibaba's equity by about 3.8%.
dilute（稀释）
这不是阿里缺钱，而是官宣：我不是一只现金回报股。
This isn't Alibaba running out of cash — it's announcing, 'I'm not a cash-return stock.'
cash-return stock（现金回报股）
paraphrase: Debt must be repaid regardless of AI's payoff.
The shareholder base is being swapped for AI believers.
scenes.speak: Debt has a promise attached — you have to repay it whether AI pays off or not. The 80-billion-HKD placement dilutes Alibaba's equity by about 3.8%. This isn't Alibaba running out of cash — it's announcing, 'I'm not a cash-return stock.'

practice: The offering was oversubscribed within the hour.
The placement dilutes existing shareholders' equity.
Cash is for survival, not for burning.
pitfalls: Say the placement means Alibaba is short on cash.
Say the cash is a survival buffer, not a war chest for betting it all.
The company keeps cash to survive downturns; the raise funds AI growth.
Blame the 10% drop entirely on dilution.
Note dilution is only ~3.8%; the rest is repricing.
Most of the move is a change in how the market values the company.
Assume debt is always cheaper or better.
Match the funding tool to the return uncertainty.
Equity shares the AI payoff risk; debt demands repayment no matter what.
Treat buybacks and placements as contradictions.
See them as one capital-rotation strategy.
Buy back low (75–80), issue high (~115) — high-sell low-buy capital management.
shifts: 以为有钱的公司就不该融资
理解融资时机买的是窗口期，结构对赌回报确定性
把配股下跌全归因于稀释
明白主要来自估值语言切换与股东换血
以为发债永远优于股权
理解长周期不确定投资更适配股权风险结构
